description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for managing embed events (such as bookerViewed, bookerReopened, bookerReloaded, and bookerReady) within a client-side embedded iframe context. It handles event firing, state management, and responsiveness for small screens.

methods.name: fireBookerViewedEvent
methods.description: Fires events indicating the Booker view has been viewed, reopened, or reloaded, based on current state and parameters.

methods.name: fireBookerReadyEvent
methods.description: Fires the 'bookerReady' event when slots are loaded and not already fired.
